method: Shared 127-case correctness corpus with an initial per-binding assessment and affected-only source, witness, coordinator and worker-recovery repairs. Shared PNG workflows reuse the actual SVG stage; a rejected SVG call is an observed shared-workflow failure, not an unrun independent PNG call. No timing samples or rendered outputs are retained.
qualificationAdjustments: Common source lexical gaps are repaired from independently reviewed contracts. Duplicate SVG IDs remain diagnostic; generic unqualified caption ownership stays unknown. Every affected observation is replaced, including prior positives and negatives, with no best-of selection.

assessmentImprovements.source: All seven common lexical/empty source gaps resolved from independently reviewed contracts; source bytes and corpus remain unchanged.
assessmentImprovements.png: Fresh full assessment of a normalized SVG witness before strict RGBA comparison. Both proved passes and failures transfer; a narrower raster observer cannot override them. Empty zero-area correctness outputs export a declared 1×1 canvas; historical DaveBench timings are unchanged.
assessmentImprovements.coordinator: Reuse the existing full SVG coordinator, including physical compound-anchor reinspection and chart evidence for domain checks. All 18 C4/sequence/state/block cases recollected for each image project.
assessmentImprovements.terminal: A timed-out worker is replaced for subsequent cases; only previously unrun cases were added to published terminal observations. CLI/browser operations use 15-second bounds; terminal and raster workers use 20 seconds.
assessmentImprovements.sharedFlowchart: Shared groups no longer make external stems/inline markers node artwork. A narrow generic flowchart profile permits only tiny actual port contacts of fully source-qualified stems or unique small attached triangular heads on shared-parent rectangular bodies; arbitrary covers remain unqualified. All 62 eligible multi-node flowchart cases recollected for DSH and VitePress, including prior passes/failures.
